decisions.rationale: Gable-front townhouse, 10.5 x 7.5 m after its quarter turn, rubble ground floor, daub and timber upper storey, shingle roof to 14.4 m; 1,014 triangles, 86,488 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Same window and door sizes as townhouse A; the two only differ in roof orientation and wall layers.
No shop front or sign: the ground floor reads as a house, not a merchant's.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Crownbridge (Crownlands) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
